correction_history.evidence: Strict UTF-8 independently failed at byte offset 5168 on 0xf6; ISO-8859-1 decoded and re-encoded all bytes exactly, produced no replacement characters, and matched the recorded non-ASCII byte histogram.

The pinned dataset contains 415 instances of lowercase data-namespace seeForStatement and zero of the uppercase data-namespace spelling; the separate vocabulary defines uppercase SeeForStatement in its distinct HTTPS namespace. Attempt 02 therefore measured its own query mismatch, not missing source scopes.

suggestion4.ttl line 54 contains the lexical placeholder 2021-03-xx typed as xsd:date. RDFLib emits the retained warning; an importer must preserve or quarantine the lexical source value rather than inventing a valid date.

conclusion: The source notes are supported after preserving their stated boundaries. The source set is feasible for a source-pinned importer; it does not support claims of ontology identity, mathematical equivalence, complete coverage, or error prevalence.
